title: meniscium deltigerum
intro: Meniscium deltigerum, commonly known as the Deltoid Meniscus Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, pain, and fever, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic effects. The bioactive constituents present in Meniscium deltigerum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Meniscium deltigerum include reducing oxidative stress, improving wound healing, and providing antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
